study: Prompt priorities, score feedback and strategy cards (changes 1-3)

conditions.baseline: Unchanged current runtime and V2 prompts
conditions.revised: Conditional priorities, component score deltas and remaining losses, three revised cards

parallelism: Five workers total; revised full cohort then baseline full cohort
initial_seed: same saved best original/deterministic proof per theorem
reference_measurements: reuse only; no original proof remeasurement
primary_comparison: Paired final local combined-score difference, revised minus baseline, across all 15 theorems only when both cohorts are complete and audited
secondary_measures: reported and estimated API-equivalent costs separately
interpretation: One exploratory warm-up replicate per arm. No causal attribution among changes 1-3, no held-out claim and no automatic adoption. Incomplete outcomes remain explicit.
execution_order_limit: Sequential cohorts keep five workers total; temporal/provider variation remains a possible confound
after_run: Audit each cohort from its own frozen runtime, even when another theorem or arm is incomplete; never automatically resample indeterminate requests
